description: Static check groups plus fix-preview must always run with zero BAS or lifecycle calls. Runtime checks must be skipped (not failed) when BAS or the UI is unavailable. A `--static-only` CLI flag and corresponding request option must run only the static groups plus fix-preview.

requirements.description: Static check groups and fix-preview must always run without any BAS or lifecycle dependency. When BAS or the scenario UI is unavailable, the runtime/render check group must be marked skipped — not failed — so that a missing browser never produces false failures.
requirements.title: Graceful degradation: runtime skipped not failed

validation.notes: When BAS is unavailable, the runtime/render group reports skipped status rather than failed Findings
When the scenario UI is down, runtime checks are skipped while static groups still produce results
Static groups and fix-preview run successfully with BAS and lifecycle entirely absent
Run ui-health with BAS stopped and confirm the Report completes with runtime skipped and exit code reflecting only static results
Unavailable runtime infrastructure never causes a false failure verdict

requirements.description: A `--static-only` CLI flag and an equivalent request option must restrict validation to the static check groups plus fix-preview, performing zero BAS or lifecycle calls even when those services are available.
requirements.title: --static-only makes zero BAS/lifecycle calls

validation.notes: The --static-only flag and request option restrict execution to static groups plus fix-preview
With --static-only set, no BAS or lifecycle calls are issued even when those services are reachable
Run `ui-health validate scenario <name> --static-only --json` and confirm only static-group and fix-preview Findings appear
--static-only provides a deterministic, infrastructure-free validation mode suitable for CI

title: Graceful degradation + --static-only
